style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the strip cells are warm sand-beige floor tiles: keys in the tile's own sandy hue (darker), a joyful berry/grape Enter clear of the blue, amber and green the pattern wears, butter soft keys, a very light panel.

images.why: Look 'A long strip of cells'; Stage 'ten cells, each 100 by 100 ... Each cell holds one shape, one arrow, or one dot'; IMAGES.md §3 row: a grid of equal cells = one tile per cell. Light sand so the deep blue, amber and green shapes drawn on top still read; the blank cell stays an empty outlined box (no skin).
images.prompt: One square glazed ceramic floor tile in a warm, light sand-beige, with a slightly deeper clay-brown edge, a soft bevelled rim and a smooth, plain satin face.

images.why: Stage 'The draw drum is 120 by 120'; Student controls 'Draw: picks the number that goes first'; Description 'a number drawn by lot'. A clay pot (matka) is what a child draws a lot from; the drawn number is drawn in code on top.
images.prompt: A round terracotta clay pot seen from above: a wide, thick, rounded rim in warm clay orange-brown around a dark, empty round mouth, with a smooth satin glaze.
